calculateRequestPrice(uint32,uint32).details: This function relies on the transaction gas price which is not automatically set duringsimulation. To estimate the price at a specific gas price, use the estimatePrice function.

params._callbackGasLimit: is the gas limit used to estimate the price.

calculateRequestPriceNative(uint32,uint3.details: This function relies on the transaction gas price which is not automatically set duringsimulation. To estimate the price at a specific gas price, use the estimatePrice function.

params._callbackGasLimit: is the gas limit used to estimate the price.
params._numWords: is the number of words to request.

estimateRequestPrice(uint32,uint32,uint2.details: This is a convenience function that can be called in simulation to better understandpricing.

params._callbackGasLimit: is the gas limit used to estimate the price.
params._requestGasPriceWei: is the gas price in wei used for the estimation.

estimateRequestPriceNative(uint32,uint32.details: This is a convenience function that can be called in simulation to better understandpricing.

params._callbackGasLimit: is the gas limit used to estimate the price.
params._numWords: is the number of words to request.
params._requestGasPriceWei: is the gas price in wei used for the estimation.

returns.coordinatorGasOverheadLink: reflects the gas overhead of the coordinator's         fulfillRandomWords function for link payment.
returns.coordinatorGasOverheadNative: reflects the gas overhead of the coordinator's         fulfillRandomWords function for native payment.
returns.coordinatorGasOverheadPerWord: reflects the gas overhead per word of the coordinator's         fulfillRandomWords function.
returns.fallbackWeiPerUnitLink: is the backup LINK exchange rate used when the LINK/NATIVE feed         is stale.
returns.fulfillmentFlatFeeLinkDiscountPPM: is the flat fee discount in millionths of native that VRFCoordinatorV2Plus         charges for link payment.
returns.fulfillmentFlatFeeNativePPM: is the flat fee in millionths of native that VRFCoordinatorV2Plus         charges for native payment.
returns.keyHash: is the key hash to use when requesting randomness. Fees are paid based on         current gas fees, so this should be set to the highest gas lane on the network.
returns.maxNumWords: is the max number of words that can be requested in a single wrapped VRF         request.
returns.stalenessSeconds: is the number of seconds before we consider the feed price to be stale         and fallback to fallbackWeiPerUnitLink.
returns.wrapperGasOverhead: reflects the gas overhead of the wrapper's fulfillRandomWords         function. The cost for this gas is passed to the user.
returns.wrapperLinkPremiumPercentage: is the premium ratio in percentage for link payment. For example, a value of 0         indicates no premium. A value of 15 indicates a 15 percent premium.
returns.wrapperNativePremiumPercentage: is the premium ratio in percentage for native payment. For example, a value of 0         indicates no premium. A value of 15 indicates a 15 percent premium.

onTokenTransfer(address,uint256,bytes).details: Reverts if payment is too low.

params._amount: is the amount of LINK paid in Juels.
params._data: is the abi-encoded VRF request parameters: uint32 callbackGasLimit,        uint16 requestConfirmations, and uint32 numWords.
params._sender: is the sender of the payment, and the address that will receive a VRF callback        upon fulfillment.

params._callbackGasLimit: is the gas limit for the request.
params._numWords: is the number of words to request.
params._requestConfirmations: number of request confirmations to wait before serving a request.

setConfig(uint32,uint32,uint32,uint16,ui.details: This function while having only 12 parameters is causing a Stack too deep error when running forge coverage.

params._size: is the size of the fulfillment transaction in bytes.

params._recipient: is the address that should receive the LINK funds.
is the address that should receive the native funds.

acceptOwnership().notice: Allows an ownership transfer to be completed by the recipient.

calculateRequestPrice(uint32,uint32).notice: Calculates the price of a VRF request with the given callbackGasLimit at the currentblock.

calculateRequestPriceNative(uint32,uint3.notice: Calculates the price of a VRF request in native with the given callbackGasLimit at the currentblock.

disable().notice: disable this contract so that new requests will be rejected. When disabled, new requestswill revert but existing requests can still be fulfilled.

enable().notice: enable this contract so that new requests can be accepted.

estimateRequestPrice(uint32,uint32,uint2.notice: Estimates the price of a VRF request with a specific gas limit and gas price.

estimateRequestPriceNative(uint32,uint32.notice: Estimates the price of a VRF request in native with a specific gas limit and gas price.

getConfig().notice: getConfig returns the current VRFV2Wrapper configuration.

onTokenTransfer(address,uint256,bytes).notice: onTokenTransfer is called by LinkToken upon payment for a VRF request.

requestRandomWordsInNative(uint32,uint16.notice: Requests randomness from the VRF V2 wrapper, paying in native token.

setCoordinator(address).notice: Sets the VRF Coordinator addressThis method should only be callable by the coordinator or contract owner

setFulfillmentTxSize(uint32).notice: setFulfillmentTxSize sets the size of the fulfillment transaction in bytes.

setL1FeeCalculation(uint8,uint8).notice: Overriding the setL1FeeCalculation function in VRFV2PlusWrapper for Optimismensures that L1_GAS_FEES_MODE can't be set for the wrapper contract.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Allows an owner to begin transferring ownership to a new address.

withdraw(address).notice: withdraw is used by the VRFV2Wrapper's owner to withdraw LINK revenue.

withdrawNative(address).notice: withdraw is used by the VRFV2Wrapper's owner to withdraw native revenue.
